summary: Comprehensive testing of simplified chatbot system completed. 19/19 backend API tests passed (100%). All frontend features verified working. The chatbot system was successfully simplified from 5 tabs (Settings, Categories, Products, Flows, Leads) to 3 tabs (Flows, Leads, Settings). Flow model now combines trigger keywords + greeting + questions + completion message + notify phone.

issues: Minor: Missing aria-describedby for DialogContent (console warning)

covered: PUT /api/chatbot/settings - Updates settings (isActive, defaultNotifyPhone, followUpDelayMinutes, maxFollowUps, followUpMessage)
POST /api/chatbot/flows - Creates flow with name, triggerKeywords, greetingMessage, completionMessage, questions (text/button/list types), notifyPhone
GET /api/chatbot/flows/{flow_id} - Returns single flow with all fields
GET /api/chatbot/leads - Returns leads with filters (status, flow_id, search, page) and stats
PUT /api/chatbot/leads/{lead_id} - Updates lead status and notes
GET /api/chatbot/leads/export - Returns CSV with headers (Phone, Name, Flow, Status, Date, question columns, Notes)
GET /api/chatbot/stats - Returns totalFlows, activeFlows, totalLeads, activeConversations
POST /api/messages/campaigns/{id}/retry-failed - Returns 404 for nonexistent campaign (not routing error)

frontend_tests.chatbot_page_tabs: PASS - ChatbotPage loads with 3 tabs (Flows, Leads, Settings) - simplified from 5 tabs
frontend_tests.flows_tab: PASS - Shows flow cards with trigger keywords, question count, greeting indicator, question preview
frontend_tests.new_flow_dialog: PASS - Contains all fields: Flow Name, Trigger Keywords, Greeting Message, Questions (with Answer Type selector: Text/Buttons/List), Completion Message, Notify Phone
frontend_tests.new_flow_creation: PASS - Can create flow with trigger keywords, greeting, text questions, button questions with options, completion message
frontend_tests.leads_tab: PASS - Shows leads with stats (Total, New, Qualified, Contacted), status filter, flow filter, search, Export CSV button
frontend_tests.settings_tab: PASS - Shows Webhook URL with Copy button, Chatbot toggle, Default Notify Phone, Follow-up Settings (delay, max, message), Save Settings button
frontend_tests.campaign_history: PASS - Shows campaigns with Retry Failed button using correct API path /api/messages/campaigns/{id}/retry-failed

seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up TEST_ prefixed flows during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Simplified chatbot system fully tested. The old complex model (Category->Product->Flow with 5 tabs) has been replaced with a simple Flow model (3 tabs: Flows, Leads, Settings). Each Flow now contains: name, triggerKeywords, greetingMessage, questions (with questionType: text/button/list and options), completionMessage, notifyPhone. DB collections: chatbot_settings, chatbot_flows (NEW), chatbot_conversations, chatbot_leads. Old collections (chatbot_categories, chatbot_products, chatbot_flow_questions) are no longer used. Retry Failed button in Campaign History uses correct path /api/messages/campaigns/{id}/retry-failed.
features_verified: Chatbot Settings: GET/PUT with webhookUrl, isActive toggle, defaultNotifyPhone, follow-up settings
Chatbot Flows CRUD: Create/Read/Update/Delete flows with trigger keywords, greeting, questions (text/button/list types), completion message, notify phone
Chatbot Leads: List with filters (status, flow_id, search, pagination), update status/notes, CSV export
Chatbot Stats: totalFlows, activeFlows, totalLeads, activeConversations
Retry Failed Messages: POST /api/messages/campaigns/{id}/retry-failed returns 404 for nonexistent (not routing error)
Frontend: 3-tab layout (Flows, Leads, Settings), New Flow dialog with all question types, flow cards with preview
